name: multi_device_scene
description: Create a new scene/group -- or add members to an existing one -- in a single call, given a list of member devices with controller/responder roles. Prefer this over repeated group_scene_op add_member calls whenever the customer describes a scene/group as a whole (e.g. 'make a scene where keypad 1 and keypad 2 are controllers and the dimmer is a responder').

group_address.description: Real id of an existing scene/group to add these members to, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE. Omit to create a new scene/group.

group_name.description: Name for the new scene/group when group_address is omitted. Omit to let NuCore assign one automatically.

devices.description: Non-empty list of member devices to add, each with its role in the scene.

link_address.description: The device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.

role.description: Whether this device triggers the scene (controller) or reacts to it (responder).

name.description: Optional display name for this member within the scene.
